statement: Linux and SDL build DS4 USB 0x05 and Bluetooth 0x11 rumble/lightbar outputs with transport-specific valid flags and CRC controls; host scheduling and output event success are not proof of physical rumble/LED parity.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 507–539, 2277–2386; SDL_hidapi_ps4.c 924–973. Physical force and lightbar calibration untested.
